item.title: Youth Business International (YBI)
item.author: emecas
item.description:
Youth Business International (YBI)
https://www.youthbusiness.org/

Entrepreneurship is a transformative option to unlock income generation. Youth entrepreneurship creates decent work for young people, strengthens communities and drives inclusive economic growth, but for too many young people, entrepreneurship is out of reach.

YBI supports young people (18-35) around the world to start, grow and sustain businesses.

Together with our members, we equip disadvantaged young people to build the skills, confidence and connections they need to beat the odds and become successful business owners.

item.title: Involvement in IEEE Mentoring Program
item.author: emecas
item.description:
Involvement in IEEE Mentoring Program
References:

- WEB - Home Membership : https://www.ieee.org/membership.htmlMentoring
https://www.ieee.org/membership/mentoring.html

- Definition
The IEEE Mentoring Program is an online program that facilitates the matching of IEEE members for the purpose of establishing a mentoring partnership. Participation in the program is completely voluntary and open to all IEEE members (all grades) and Society Affiliates. To participate in the IEEE Mentoring Program, visit IEEE Collabratec: https://ieee-collabratec.ieee.org/?utm_source=MGA&utm_medium=Website&utm_campaign=MentorProgram_41215&utm_content=Link&utm_term=Organic&WT.mc_id=MGA_Website_Link_Organic_MentorProgram_41215® and sign in with your IEEE Account.
